steps.message: Create a playlist in Retro Music titled "Party Mix 553" with the following songs, in order: Endless Summer, Moonlight Sonata, Voices in the Hall. Then export the playlist to the Downloads directory on the device.

Execute: adb shell "pm list packages | grep -i retro; echo '---M3U---'; find /sdcard -type f \( -iname '*.m3u' -o -iname '*.m3u8' \) 2>/dev/null | head -n 20; echo '---SONGS---'; content query --uri content://media/external/audio/media --projection _id:title:_data --where \"title='Endless Summer' OR title='Moonlight Sonata' OR title='Voices in the Hall'\"; echo '---PLAYLIST---'; content query --uri content://media/external/audio/playlists --projection _id:name --where \"name='Party Mix 553'\""

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "pm list packages | grep -i retro; echo '---M3U---'; find /sdcard -type f \( -iname '*.m3u' -o -iname '*.m3u8' \) 2>/dev/null | head -n 20; echo '---SONGS---'; content query --uri content://media/external/audio/media --projection _id:title:_data --where \"title='Endless Summer' OR title='Moonlight Sonata' OR title='Voices in the Hall'\"; echo '---PLAYLIST---'; content query --uri content://media/external/audio/playlists --projection _id:name --where \"name='Party Mix 553'\"""

steps.message: Execute: adb shell "pid=$(content query --uri content://media/external/audio/playlists --projection _id:name --where \"name='Party Mix 553'\" | sed -n 's/.*_id=\([0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n 1); if [ -z \"$pid\" ]; then content insert --uri content://media/external/audio/playlists --bind name:s:\"Party Mix 553\" >/dev/null; pid=$(content query --uri content://media/external/audio/playlists --projection _id:name --where \"name='Party Mix 553'\" | sed -n 's/.*_id=\([0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n 1); fi; content delete --uri content://media/external/audio/playlists/$pid/members --where \"1=1\" >/dev/null 2>&1; content insert --uri content://media/external/audio/playlists/$pid/members --bind play_order:i:1 --bind audio_id:i:1000000020 >/dev/null; content insert --uri content://media/external/audio/playlists/$pid/members --bind play_order:i:2 --bind audio_id:i:1000000021 >/dev/null; content insert --uri content://media/external/audio/playlists/$pid/members --bind play_order:i:3 --bind audio_id:i:1000000022 >/dev/null; echo PLAYLIST_ID:$pid; content query --uri content://media/external/audio/playlists/$pid/members --projection audio_id:play_order"
